event: A Digital Minds Research Sprint submission on framing effects reports that self-report was found to be an unreliable guide to behavior, cautioning against trusting a model's account of its own reasoning or reading model self-reports as evidence of self-knowledge. The authors treat the gap between a model's stated belief about its own invariance and its measured behavior as a measure of self-report reliability. (Digital Minds Research Sprint, 2026-11-03.)
